deadline.value: Fall applications are due January 15; spring applications are due September 15.
deadline.quote: APPLICATION DEADLINE: January 15 (for fall entry) or September 15 (for spring entry)

gre_general.value: The department requires the GRE General Test; the Physics Subject Test is optional.
gre_general.quote: GRE scores (General Test required, Physics Subject Test optional)

gre_subject.value: The GRE Physics Subject Test is optional and can be sent if available.
gre_subject.quote: It is not required, but if one is available it can be sent as part of your application package

supervisor.value: The department pages do not say whether a faculty supervisor must agree before admission.

funding.value: Virtually all incoming students get a teaching assistantship for their first year or two.
funding.quote: Virtually all incoming students are offered a teaching assistantship for the first year or two

entry_route.value: The pages set a GPA minimum but do not say whether a master's degree is needed.

notes: Ph.D. in Physics only; the department page lists no separate astronomy doctorate.
